mapper.sql: id, public_id, cluster_name, cluster_name_key, product_scope, function_module, issue_category, canonical_symptom, canonical_object, canonical_trigger, error_signature, total_record_count, channel_distribution, cluster_status, lifecycle_version, statistics_version, statistics_reconciled_at, merged_into_cluster_id, split_from_cluster_id, status_changed_by, status_changed_at, status_reason, vector_index_status, search_index_status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_cluster WHERE id > #{afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_cluster(public_id, cluster_name, cluster_name_key, product_scope, function_module, issue_category, canonical_symptom, canonical_object, canonical_trigger, error_signature, total_record_count, channel_distribution, cluster_status, vector_index_status, search_index_status, split_from_cluster_id) VALUES(#{row.publicId}, #{row.clusterName}, #{row.clusterNameKey}, #{row.productScope}, #{row.functionModule}, #{row.issueCategory}, #{row.canonicalSymptom}, #{row.canonicalObject}, #{row.canonicalTrigger}, #{row.errorSignature}, 0, JSON_OBJECT(), 'ACTIVE', 'PENDING', 'PENDING', #{row.splitFromClusterId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)

INSERT INTO t_cluster(public_id, cluster_name, cluster_name_key, product_scope, function_module, issue_category, canonical_symptom, canonical_object, canonical_trigger, error_signature, total_record_count, channel_distribution, cluster_status, vector_index_status, search_index_status, split_from_cluster_id) VALUES
(#{row.publicId}, #{row.clusterName}, #{row.clusterNameKey}, #{row.productScope}, #{row.functionModule}, #{row.issueCategory}, #{row.canonicalSymptom}, #{row.canonicalObject}, #{row.canonicalTrigger}, #{row.errorSignature}, 0, JSON_OBJECT(), 'ACTIVE', 'PENDING', 'PENDING', #{row.splitFromClusterId})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_cluster SET cluster_status = #{row.targetStatus}, lifecycle_version = lifecycle_version + 1, merged_into_cluster_id = #{row.mergedIntoClusterId}, status_changed_by = #{row.operatorId}, status_changed_at = NOW(3), status_reason = #{row.reason}, total_record_count = CASE WHEN #{row.clearStatistics} THEN 0 ELSE total_record_count END, channel_distribution = CASE WHEN #{row.clearStatistics} THEN JSON_OBJECT() ELSE channel_distribution END, search_index_status = 'PENDING', vector_index_status = 'PENDING', updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{row.id} AND lifecycle_version = #{row.expectedVersion}

UPDATE t_cluster SET cluster_status = CASE id WHEN #{row.id} THEN #{row.targetStatus} ELSE cluster_status END, lifecycle_version = lifecycle_version + 1, merged_into_cluster_id = CASE id WHEN #{row.id} THEN #{row.mergedIntoClusterId} ELSE merged_into_cluster_id END, status_changed_by = CASE id WHEN #{row.id} THEN #{row.operatorId} ELSE status_changed_by END, status_changed_at = NOW(3), status_reason = CASE id WHEN #{row.id} THEN #{row.reason} ELSE status_reason END, total_record_count = CASE id WHEN #{row.id} THEN IF(#{row.clearStatistics},0,total_record_count) ELSE total_record_count END, channel_distribution = CASE id WHEN #{row.id} THEN IF(#{row.clearStatistics},JSON_OBJECT(),channel_distribution) ELSE channel_distribution END, search_index_status = 'PENDING', vector_index_status = 'PENDING', updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE
(id = #{row.id} AND lifecycle_version = #{row.expectedVersion})

UPDATE t_cluster SET lifecycle_version = lifecycle_version + 1, status_changed_by = #{row.operatorId}, status_changed_at = NOW(3), status_reason = #{row.reason}, search_index_status = 'PENDING', vector_index_status = 'PENDING', updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{row.id} AND lifecycle_version = #{row.expectedVersion}

UPDATE t_cluster SET cluster_status = 'REOPENED', lifecycle_version = lifecycle_version + 1, status_changed_by = NULL, status_changed_at = NOW(3), status_reason = #{reason}, search_index_status = 'PENDING', vector_index_status = 'PENDING', updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND lifecycle_version = #{expectedVersion} AND cluster_status = 'RESOLVED'

UPDATE t_cluster SET total_record_count = CASE id WHEN #{row.clusterId} THEN #{row.totalCount} ELSE total_record_count END, channel_distribution = CASE id WHEN #{row.clusterId} THEN CAST(#{row.channelDistribution} AS JSON) ELSE channel_distribution END, statistics_version = statistics_version + 1, statistics_reconciled_at = NOW(3), search_index_status = 'PENDING', vector_index_status = 'PENDING', updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id IN #{row.clusterId}

UPDATE t_cluster SET cluster_name = #{newName}, cluster_name_key = #{nameKey}, canonical_symptom = #{newName}, lifecycle_version = lifecycle_version + 1, search_index_status = 'PENDING', vector_index_status = 'PENDING', updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND cluster_name = #{oldName} AND lifecycle_version = #{expectedVersion} AND cluster_status IN ('ACTIVE','MITIGATING','REOPENED')
